notes: Generate a JPEG master for every entry, 1280x720 or larger, 16:9, photorealistic, as if shot on a real camera in natural or available light. No cartoons, illustrations, flat vector, or stylised art. No faces and no real identifiable people. Generic hands or distant anonymous figures only if a prompt asks for them; these prompts do not. No company logos, wordmarks, flags, seals, or readable brand names or text. Do not stage a press conference, signing, protest, hearing, or other news event. New-story posts are draft:true until these masters exist and npm run art has been run. src/_data/imageSizes.json contains temporary dimension stubs (pending:true) so Eleventy can render the drafts in serve mode; npm run art rewrites that file from JPEGs on disk, so add every master before running art or the draft render will fail again. Post front matter uses credit "Image: AI Headline Hub" and licence "AI Headline Hub". Do not put an AI-generated label in alt text or captions.
